description: S458: text after a refinement's closing parenthesis that is not exactly one `[label]` (nor array suffixes `[]`, nor `?`) makes the annotation malformed. `number(>0) foo` is refused with E-CONTRACT-002 — it is neither silently untyped (no check) nor silently read as `number(>0)` with the tail ignored.
rationale: §53.2.1: `inline-predicate = base-type "(" predicate-expr ")"`, optionally followed by `"[" identifier "]"` (named-constraint). Any other tail is outside the grammar; §53.11 E-CONTRACT-002 covers a malformed predicate.
